# ADR-034 — Firebase/FCM and Groq configuration exist in local development only (MVP)

**Status:** Locked for MVP

<!-- Decision text below is verbatim from the pre-split docs/DECISIONS.md table row (2026-09-16). Do not edit a Locked decision without explicit owner approval. -->

Firebase/FCM and Groq AI-provider configuration exist in **local development only**. Production has neither; provisioning production is a separate, deliberate step **[Present state corrected by ADR-057.]**
